tasks.short: Write technical reports and statistical charts.

steps.what: Collect, check and select actual technical statistics and data for the report
outputs: verified technical report data and chosen findings

steps.what: Draw charts that display verified statistics and data
inputs: verified technical report data and chosen findings

steps.what: Write technical reports explaining actual statistics, data and chosen findings
inputs: verified technical report data and chosen findings

loop.purpose: Draft explanations of verified technical findings
loop.input: Actual verified report data, charts, chosen findings and limitations
loop.check: Drafter checks technical meaning, omitted conditions, chart descriptions and unsupported causal claims against actual data and chosen findings
loop.stop: Missing actual source or two failed revisions returns report writing to manual work
loop.why_not_simpler: Native chart links and fixed report headings handle structured content; explanations vary with findings

steps.what: Check the final technical report, charts, source references and disclosure scope
inputs: verified technical report data and chosen findings

steps.what: Save the checked final technical report version

tasks.design: Configure native chart links from {SPREADSHEET} into {DOCS}, then use a bounded draft for explanations of the drafter's verified findings. Source assembly and meaning checks remain human; the exact final report is checked before its separate save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reports can repeat chart entry and narrative writing from verified technical data.
tasks.enabler_now: Native chart templates and bounded source-linked prose can reduce repetitive preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Data relevance, misleading charts and technical interpretation need human judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The drafter notices when a correct number or fluent explanation gives the wrong technical impression.
tasks.altitude: Less chart entry and first-draft prose; report responsibility stays unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: linked charts and bounded source-linked writing can support technical reports; source selection and technical meaning still need checking.

assumptions: Boundary is report writing through its checked saved version. Publication or client distribution remains an actual separate release action with no saved release labour claimed.

Actual project or test producer supplies source identifier, date, metric, value, unit and version. Drafter assembles, manually completes and verifies rows and chooses findings in s1 before s2. Missing source capture is counted in s1, never assumed free.
Test native charts and report templates before code. Already-linked charts earn no new saving; generated meaning correction stays in s3 and the complete final report check in s4.
Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Same-system save retains one percent and uses the existing report check.
unknowns: How much report narrative repeats verified findings?
research_questions: Does assisted reporting save time after checking chart meaning and correcting all unsupported claims?

already_counted.description: Correct technical narrative meaning within s3.

incremental.description: Maintain chart links and report drafting checks.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final technical report, exact version and document destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20 chart entry + 35*0.40 prose = 34; minus 2 upkeep = 32. If half the charts and prose are eligible, 17 minus 2 = 15. Source assembly, final checks and save time stay unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Supervise printed-circuit-board drafting, layout, assembly or testing work.

steps.what: Find actual printed-circuit-board work status and current instructions
Choose, enter and check actual board-work assignments and dependencies
Commit the checked actual board-work assignments
Supervise and coordinate workers drafting, designing layouts, assembling or testing printed circuit boards
inputs: actual board work and worker questions
outputs: actual board supervision observations and agreements

steps.what: Write and check actual board-work outcomes, issues and follow-up requirements
inputs: actual board supervision observations and agreements

steps.what: Save the checked actual board supervision record

tasks.design: Configure existing board-work filters and linked instruction fields in {PROJECT}. The drafter chooses assignments, supervises actual work and records observed outcomes; only status finding and repeated board/instruction references change.
tasks.previous_blocker: Board supervision can repeat status lookup and assignment reference entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native board-work views and linked instruction fields can reduce that repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Worker coaching, defect recognition and resolving competing work requirements remain human.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor recognises a technique or coordination problem before the status record shows it.
tasks.altitude: Supervision and assignment judgement stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native project views and linked instruction references can reduce supervision paperwork; actual worker supervision remains human.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual supervision and existing assignment/outcome records. Drafting, assembly or test workers' own labour is outside this denominator; do not invent a supervisory report where none is written.

Work-item owners supply actual board identifier, status and instruction revision; supervisor verifies these in s1 and chooses workers in s2. Actual agreements and outcomes arise in s4 and are captured manually in s5. Missing or stale fields stay manual; no completion is inferred from an assignment.

Test native project views and linked fields before code. Existing status automation earns no saving. Only repeated reference entry changes within s2; assignment choices, supervision and actual outcome notes remain retained.
Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Each commit/save retains one percent and uses the existing assignment or outcome-record check.
unknowns: Are board work and instruction links already visible?
Which supervision records are actually written?
research_questions: Is enough reference entry repeated to justify native configuration?

incremental.description: Maintain board-work filters and instruction links.

approvals.approved_version: s2 checked final actual board-work assignments and exact project destinations; edits require recheck
s5 checked final actual board supervision record and exact project destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 5*0.20 finding + 9*0.20 repeated assignment fields = 2.8; minus 0.5 upkeep = 2.3. With half the lookup and fields eligible, 1.4 minus 0.5 = 0.9. Supervision and actual outcome records stay unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Train students in drafting machines and electrical diagrams.

steps.what: Prepare and check actual drafting-machine exercises and schematic or interconnection diagram examples
Save the checked final drafting lesson examples
Train students to use drafting machines and prepare the actual electrical diagrams
outputs: actual student practice and teaching observations

steps.what: Assess actual student drawings and write and check feedback and training records
inputs: actual student practice and teaching observations
outputs: checked final actual student feedback and training record

steps.what: Save the checked actual student feedback and training record
inputs: checked final actual student feedback and training record
outputs: saved actual student feedback and training record

tasks.design: Reuse actual lesson drawing components in the engineering drawing system {OTHER} and checked examples in {DOCS}. The drafter chooses and checks examples, teaches hands-on and judges actual student drawings; student feedback and records are created only after the teaching and practice.
tasks.previous_blocker: New or revised lessons can repeat drawing of unchanged example components.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reusable drawing components can reduce that repeated lesson-example entry.
tasks.still_hard: Students need demonstrations, observation and feedback on actual diagram and machine-use mistakes.
tasks.human_edge: The trainer understands the student's misconception and demonstrates a correction.
tasks.altitude: Less example redrawing; teaching and assessment responsibility stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: drawing-component libraries can reuse teaching-example geometry; teaching and judging students' electrical diagrams remain human.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual preparation of new or revised teaching examples, teaching and existing feedback records. Reusing an unchanged existing course has no repeated preparation baseline: reweight to actual work, and never charge per-student preparation where it happens once per course.

Trainer supplies actual learning objective and selects actual existing example revisions in s1. Missing examples are drawn manually; no automatic pedagogical choice is assumed. Students produce actual drawings in s3; trainer assesses and captures actual feedback in s4.
Test native reusable examples before code. Existing configured lesson reuse earns no saving. Teaching, diagram assessment, actual feedback writing and record entry remain fully retained.
Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Both saves retain one percent and use existing example and feedback checks, without extra approval steps.
unknowns: How often are new or revised lesson examples actually prepared?
What student feedback records are actually written?
research_questions: Can native components reduce actual example redrawing after course-level reuse is accounted for?

approvals.approved_version: s1 checked final drafting lesson examples and exact document destination; edits require recheck
s4 checked final actual student feedback and training record and exact student destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 19*0.20 actual lesson-example redrawing = 3.8; minus 0.5 upkeep = 3.3. If half the example geometry is reusable, 1.9 minus 0.5 = 1.4. No recurring preparation is invented and teaching or feedback time is not cut.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare specifications and calculate weights, volumes or stress factors.

steps.what: Interpret actual specifications and choose applicable weight, volume or stress calculation methods
outputs: chosen specification interpretation and calculation methods

steps.what: Enter and verify actual geometry, materials, loads and units for the calculations
inputs: chosen specification interpretation and calculation methods

steps.what: Calculate weights, volumes or stress factors using the actual selected formulas
inputs: chosen specification interpretation and calculation methods
outputs: source-linked weight volume or stress calculations

steps.what: Prepare actual specification explanations and calculated-result references
inputs: source-linked weight volume or stress calculations
chosen specification interpretation and calculation methods

loop.purpose: Draft specification explanations from actual interpreted requirements and calculations
loop.input: Drafter-chosen interpretation, actual calculations and source references
loop.check: Drafter checks technical meaning, omitted conditions, units and unsupported claims about loads or tolerances against actual interpretation and calculations
loop.stop: Missing actual calculation source or two failed revisions returns writing to manual work
loop.why_not_simpler: Native result fields and fixed specification headings come first; explanations of interpreted requirements vary

steps.what: Check the final specifications, calculation applicability, source revisions and destination
inputs: chosen specification interpretation and calculation methods

steps.what: Save the checked final calculated specification record

tasks.design: Configure actual design-input links and checked formulas in the engineering calculation system {OTHER} or {SPREADSHEET}. Use fixed result fields before bounded specification prose in {DOCS}; the drafter interprets requirements and checks calculation applicability and the exact final specification before saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Specifications can repeat geometry entry, routine arithmetic and explanatory prose.
tasks.enabler_now: Native links and checked formula configurations can reduce repeated input and calculation work; bounded drafting can start the explanation.
tasks.still_hard: Formula applicability, load assumptions and specification meaning require engineering judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The drafter detects when a correct formula answers the wrong engineering question.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated input, arithmetic and prose; specification authority stays unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: engineering calculation tools can reuse actual design inputs and selected formulas; bounded source-linked drafting can support explanations but cannot establish calculation applicability.

assumptions: Weights, volumes and stress factors are alternative calculations, not mandatory simultaneous tasks. Boundary ends at a checked saved specification; engineering release and physical manufacture remain actual owner actions with no saved labour claimed.

Designer supplies actual geometry and revision, material owner actual density or properties, and engineer actual loads where required. Drafter chooses applicable method in s1 and verifies dimensions, units and source mapping in s2. Missing or incompatible fields stay manual before s3. No free structured load assumptions are assumed.

Test native design links and formulas before code. Existing automatic calculations and solver runtime earn no saving; only actual manual repeated input and arithmetic change. All requirement interpretation, formula choice and generated meaning correction remain retained.
Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Same-system save retains one percent and uses the existing specification check.
unknowns: Which calculations and inputs are already linked?
research_questions: Can configured formulas reproduce actual prior specifications including unit and boundary-condition edge cases?

already_counted.description: Correct specification explanation meaning within s4.

incremental.description: Maintain input links, checked formulas and specification drafting checks.

approvals.approved_version: s5 checked final calculated specification record, exact revision and document destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20*0.25 input entry + 20 arithmetic + 24*0.30 prose = 32.2; minus 1.5 upkeep = 30.7. If half the input, calculations and prose are eligible, 16.1 minus 1.5 = 14.6. Interpretation, checks and final save remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The drafter retains interpretation, supervision and teaching while repeated charts, examples and calculations can shrink.
skills_to_grow: Technical checking of generated specification prose
role.ambitious_version: Decision rights stay unchanged; validate lower repeated preparation effort on actual drafting, teaching and supervisory work.
